description: Localization keys for diagnostics produced while rendering a template.

members.name: BlockedUrlScheme
members.description: A link, image or background used a URL scheme outside the allow-list and was replaced with # (§3.7a). Localized by the host; the resource entry lives in the editor package under the same key.

members.name: EventHandlerRemoved
members.description: Raw markup carried an event-handler attribute (on*) or srcdoc, which was removed because a variable inside it would run as script. The editor package carries the resource entry.

members.name: MarkupTooComplex
members.description: The rendered markup could not be checked within the guard's regex budget, so it was discarded and the render failed (Error): unchecked markup is never returned.

members.name: UnsafeElementRemoved
members.description: Markup that can rewrite a link at runtime was removed: an SVG animation element (set/animate/animateMotion/animateTransform/discard) or a meta http-equiv="refresh" redirect. E-mail has no legitimate use for either.
